title: 液流电池效率关系
test_conditions: Original unnamed flow-cell ledger; Q and integral(V dQ) are supplied for each branch; voltage means are capacity-weighted; excludes pump/auxiliary energy and all system-level claims
creator: VoltPeer maintainers
limitations: Declared teaching model only; no measured device, mechanism or material certification. This generator does not adapt experimental data.

equations: Branch V(Q)=Vmean+tilt*(2*Q/Qtotal-1), tilt_charge=0.08 V, tilt_discharge=-0.06 V
assumptions: Positive capacity and energy in both branches over identical declared cycle boundaries.
Cell DC energy only; linear V(Q) permits an exact trapezoidal integral.
